description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Metrics Service, providing methods for batch retrieving and putting metrics asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: SageMakerMetricsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon SageMaker Metrics Service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: batchGetMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves metrics in batch from SageMaker Metrics Service.

methods.name: batchGetMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves metrics in batch from SageMaker Metrics Service.

methods.name: batchPutMetrics
methods.description: Sends metrics data in batch to SageMaker Metrics Service.

methods.name: batchPutMetricsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends metrics data in batch to SageMaker Metrics Service.
